Shot 4：巨树根部35度斜角（Dutch angle）极限大仰拍垂直急摇向上，橙冠小火灵化作橙红火线沿粗糙树皮螺旋蹿上高枝；画面左下方前景中白鹿角森女双脚稳踩地面草丛，仰头咬唇，右手猛挥甩出两条发光翠绿藤蔓斜穿画面直抽树冠。<破空鞭响与火苗呼啸> 切于翠绿藤鞭缠住高处树枝猛然下扯的一瞬。

Shot 5：从高处树冠垂直向下俯瞰的俯冲跟拍镜头（先俯视地面仰头的白鹿角森女，随即随火灵一同垂直坠落），树枝被藤鞭拽弯洒下漫天晨露，橙冠小火灵脚下一滑，镜头紧贴着旋转坠落的橙冠小火灵朝地面红伞蘑菇林极速垂直俯冲。<树枝绷紧脆响与急速下坠风声> 切于橙冠小火灵即将撞上首朵红伞蘑菇菌盖的一瞬。

Shot 6：固定在红伞蘑菇菌盖表面的贴物超近景广角，橙冠小火灵迎面砸在前景红色菌盖上压出深深凹陷，炸开一圈橙红火浪后贴着镜头上方弹飞出去；半秒内白鹿角森女的双掌从画面右侧猛扑抓过菌盖边缘，菌盖剧烈回弹。<Q弹蘑菇重音与扑空擦响> 切于她猛然转头看向右侧第二朵蘑菇。

Shot 7：贴草皮脚踝高度180度极速环绕旋转镜头，以白鹿角森女为中心高速环绕，橙冠小火灵在外圈草地上极速画圈狂奔，瞬间拉出一道360度猛烈燃烧的橙红火墙将镜头与白鹿角森女同时围在中央；她琥珀色双眸凌厉一凛，双臂交叉向外猛振。<烈焰轰鸣成环与衣袖震响> 切于身旁浅溪轰然炸起水柱的一瞬。

Shot 8：林间大远景正侧对称极速拉远，展现巨树与空地全貌，白鹿角森女立于画面正中，双手牵引两股巨型碧蓝清泉水龙卷向左右两侧同时横扫，水浪与橙红火墙猛烈碰撞，漫天白雾与花瓣向高空席卷，整圈火墙瞬间熄灭。<澎湃水浪轰鸣与漫天蒸汽嘶响> 切于橙冠小火灵从右侧白雾中冲出。

Shot 9：紧贴橙冠小火灵后背的第一人称追尾视角贴地极速前冲，镜头紧随小火灵穿过低矮蕨丛，前方左右地面突然破土刺出六道发光翠绿藤蔓，在镜头正前方极速交织成一面翠绿藤网封死去路。<破土脆响与藤蔓极速交织声> 切于橙冠小火灵贴近藤网急刹鼓腮。

Shot 10：正对橙冠小火灵面门的反向倒退跟拍（镜头向后高速退行），橙冠小火灵喷出一颗橙红火球炸穿藤网冲向镜头，而后方裂开的藤网缺口处，白鹿角森女拨开残藤极速欺近，睁大的琥珀色双眼紧锁小火灵。<火球爆裂与疾步破风声> 切于她右手提前探向侧面溪边青石。

Shot 11：紧贴浅溪水面的镜像倒影仰拍急抬，水面清晰映出白鹿角森女凌厉的眉眼，她指尖挑破水面，三道弧形碧蓝水环如飞轮般破水而出，镜头随三道水环极速向上仰摇，直追半空跳跃的橙冠小火灵。<三声高频水刃破水鸣响> 切于三道水环从左、右、上三路呈品字形锁死橙冠小火灵。

Shot 12：右上方45度高空斜角俯冲急推，俯拍青石上方被三道水环逼停的橙冠小火灵，左下角白鹿角森女嘴角扬起一抹洞悉一切的灵动笑意，双脚稳踩青石旁草地，沾满水光的双掌由下往上合拢前掬。<轻快脚步声与清越水鸣> 切于双掌在橙冠小火灵周身合围的一瞬。

Shot 13：绕白鹿角森女双掌120度高速弧线环绕特写，三道碧蓝水环与掌心水光瞬间融合成一颗晶莹剔透的彩虹水气泡，将橙冠小火灵稳稳困在球心，细碎发光水珠沿环绕轨迹向四周飞散。<清脆晶莹的成球叮咚声> 切于水气泡在掌心上方轻弹稳住。

Shot 14：从晶莹水气泡内部向外看的透视主观特写，前景是橙冠小火灵贴在气泡内壁上的两只发光小火手与圆黑大眼后脑勺，透过弧形水膜看出去，外侧的白鹿角森女双肩轻轻松落，紧蹙的眉头舒展，长舒一口气吹起额前白发。<轻柔水泡嗡鸣与温暖舒气声> 切于白鹿角森女微笑着歪头靠近气泡。

Shot 15：低角度四分之三侧面仰拍（林间翠绿阳光透过白色鹿角洒下，水气泡悬于画面右侧，左侧白鹿角森女整张脸完全无遮挡），她琥珀色大眼中满是温柔又无奈的狡黠笑意，缓缓抬起右手修长的食指伸向右侧气泡。<林间微风与衣袂轻响> 切于食指指尖逼近水膜外壁。

Shot 16：指尖与火掌隔膜相触的极限微距正侧特写，画面中央垂直弧形水膜左侧是白鹿角森女白皙的食指指尖轻轻一点，右侧气泡内是橙冠小火灵伸出小小橙红火掌精准贴在同一位置回点，一圈金碧交织的涟漪沿水膜上下扩散。<清脆如琉璃的轻叩声与欢快火苗噼啪> 切于金碧涟漪漾开的一瞬。

Shot 17：越过右侧发光气泡肩部的左前侧反向近景，气泡内橙冠小火灵温暖的橙红火光映亮白鹿角森女白皙的脸颊与弯成月牙的琥珀色双眸，她看着气泡里翻跟头的小火灵露出开心柔和的笑容。<轻快水泡咕噜声> 切于她双手轻轻托高气泡。

Shot 18：由双人中近景向林间丁达尔光束高处平稳拉升的摇臂远景收尾，阳光穿过参天古树照亮整片翠绿空地，白鹿角森女立于溪畔草地上微笑着凝视身旁右肩侧悬浮的橙红发光水气泡，画面在最温暖明亮的瞬间干净硬切结束，不渐隐。<清越水音与森林鸟鸣尾音>

Do not change the character's identity.

## 3. MAIN COMPOSITION — EXTREME FORCED PERSPECTIVE

Create an extraordinary, ultra-realistic, premium commercial advertising photograph.

Place the product prominently in the extreme foreground, positioned in the lower-center portion of the image.

The product should appear dramatically oversized due to an extreme wide-angle forced-perspective camera technique.

Position the character several feet behind the product, standing in the background.

The character extends one arm directly toward the camera, reaching forward as if presenting, grabbing or interacting with the product.

**IMPORTANT:** The hand must appear dramatically larger due to perspective, occupying a significant portion of the foreground, while the character's face and body remain clearly recognizable in the background.

Create realistic spatial depth between the hand, product and character.

## 4. CHARACTER STYLING

Dress the character in a stylish, fashionable outfit that complements the product's color palette and advertising concept.

Natural confident expression, realistic body posture and believable hand anatomy.

The character should look directly toward the camera or toward the product.

## 5. ENVIRONMENT & BACKGROUND

Create a beautiful minimalist futuristic studio environment.

Use a clean, vibrant monochromatic background or a complementary color scheme inspired by the product's packaging.

Include:
- Geometric architectural shapes.
- Smooth curved studio walls.
- Minimalist flooring.
- Subtle geometric shadows.
- Clean commercial set design.

Keep the environment visually striking but uncluttered.

## 6. CAMERA & PHOTOGRAPHY

- Vertical 9:16 advertising composition.
- Extreme wide-angle 18mm lens perspective.
- Low camera placement near product level.
- Dramatic forced-perspective effect.
- Product sharply visible in the foreground.
- Character visible in the background.
- Hand reaching toward the lens.
- Strong foreground-to-background depth.
- Professional luxury advertising photography.

## 7. LIGHTING & PRODUCT PRESENTATION

Use premium commercial studio lighting.

Create beautiful controlled highlights on the product, realistic reflections, soft contact shadows and natural material textures.

Ensure the product's branding and packaging are clearly visible and readable.

Character's face must remain naturally illuminated with realistic skin texture.

## 8. VISUAL QUALITY

Ultra-photorealistic luxury commercial campaign, premium international advertising aesthetic, professional product photography, realistic human anatomy, physically believable perspective, sophisticated color grading, exceptional material details, sharp product presentation and cinematic depth.

## 9. STRICT NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS

No incorrect product design, no altered branding, no misspelled logos, no invented labels, no duplicate products, no distorted hands, no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no distorted face, no plastic skin, no cartoon appearance, no unnecessary props, no watermark, no random text.

## 10. FINAL OUTPUT

Create one visually striking, premium-quality commercial advertising image featuring the uploaded product and uploaded character together.

The product must remain the hero subject in the foreground, while the character creates a dramatic forced-perspective interaction in the background.

**RESOLUTION LOCK:** Generate final images in 16K resolution — 15360 × 8640 pixels (≈132.7 million pixels), 16:9 aspect ratio.

## 1. 产品身份与保留

重现上传的产品参考图中所展示的确切产品。

保留：
- 原始产品形状与比例。
- 完全一致的包装与容器设计。
- 原始颜色与材质。
- 品牌名称、标志与字体排印。
- 标签、印刷文字与独特细节。
- 原始瓶盖、盖子、按钮或其他产品组件。

不要重新设计、简化、替换或臆造产品特征。

## 2. 人物身份锁定

使用上传的人物参考图作为确切的面部身份参考。

保留面部结构、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、发型、发色与自然身体比例。

不要改变人物的身份。

## 3. 主要构图 — 极端强迫透视

创作一张非凡、超写实、高端商业广告照片。

将产品置于画面最前景的显眼位置，位于画面下方中央区域。

产品应因极端广角强迫透视的相机技法而显得戏剧性地巨大。

将人物安排在产品后方数英尺处，站在背景中。

人物将一只手臂直接伸向镜头，向前伸出，仿佛在展示、抓握或与产品互动。

**重要：** 手部必须因透视关系而显得戏剧性地巨大，占据前景相当大的部分，同时人物的面部与身体在背景中依然清晰可辨。

在手部、产品与人物之间创造真实的空间纵深。

## 4. 人物造型

为人物搭配时尚、有品位且与产品配色和广告概念相协调的服装。

自然自信的表情、真实的身体姿态与可信的手部解剖结构。

人物应直接望向镜头或望向产品。

## 5. 环境与背景

打造 beautiful 极简的未来的影棚环境。

使用干净、明亮的单色背景，或受产品包装启发的互补配色方案。

包括：
- 几何建筑形状。
- 平滑弧形的影棚墙面。
- 极简地面。
- 微妙的几何阴影。
- 干净的商业布景设计。

保持环境视觉上引人注目但不杂乱。

## 6. 相机与摄影

- 竖幅 9:16 广告构图。
- 极端广角 18mm 镜头透视。
- 接近产品高度的低机位设置。
- 戏剧性的强迫透视效果。
- 产品在前景中锐利清晰可见。
- 人物在背景中可见。
- 手部伸向镜头。
- 从前景到背景的强烈纵深感。
- 专业奢华广告摄影。

## 7. 灯光与产品呈现

使用高端商业影棚灯光。

在产品上营造漂亮而可控的高光、真实的反射、柔和的接触阴影与自然的材质纹理。

确保产品的品牌标识与包装清晰可见且可读。

人物面部必须保持自然受光，并呈现真实的皮肤质感。

## 8. 视觉质量

超写实奢华商业广告大片、高端国际广告美学、专业产品摄影、真实的人体解剖结构、物理上可信的透视关系、精致的色彩分级、非凡的材质细节、锐利的产品呈现与电影级纵深感。

## 9. 严格负面约束

不要出现错误的产品设计、不要更改品牌标识、不要拼写错误的标志、不要臆造的标签、不要重复出现的产品、不要变形的手、不要多出手指、不要多余的肢体、不要扭曲的面部、不要塑料感皮肤、不要卡通化外观、不要不必要的道具、不要水印、不要随机文字。

## 10. 最终输出

创作一张视觉冲击力强、高品质的商业广告图像，同时呈现上传的产品与上传的人物。

产品必须保持作为前景主角主体地位，同时人物在背景中形成戏剧性的强迫透视互动。

**分辨率锁定：** 最终图像以 16K 分辨率生成 — 15360 × 8640 像素（约 1.327 亿像素），16:9 宽高比。

重要：保持所要求的竖幅 9:16 广告构图。

Task: Create a 3:4 Split-Panel Photo-to-Japanese Illustration Poster

Transform the uploaded photograph into a vertically composed 3:4 comparison poster. The upper half displays the original photograph, while the lower half features a Japanese hand-drawn manga illustration with a limited-color print-poster aesthetic, faithfully redrawn from the same photograph.

Divide the canvas into two equal horizontal sections, each occupying exactly 50% of the total height. Both sections must have the same width. The horizontal division should connect seamlessly, with no gap, border, overlap, or decorative separator.

1. Upper Half — Original Photograph

- Preserve the original photograph exactly as it is.
- Do not redraw, recolor, retouch, or add any text to the photograph.
- Scale proportionally without stretching or distorting the image.
- If necessary, crop peripheral background areas first while preserving the main subject and important visual details.
- If the aspect ratio cannot be accommodated without compromising essential content, extend the edges with a light grayish-cream background. Never invent or reconstruct missing parts of the original photograph.

2. Lower Half — Japanese Hand-Drawn Illustration

Redraw the photograph as a Japanese-inspired hand-drawn manga illustration with a minimalist, limited-color screen-print poster aesthetic.

The original photograph is the exclusive source of the subject's identity, appearance, pose, structure, composition, layout, and relationships between objects.

For people:

- Preserve recognizable facial shape, hairstyle silhouette, expression, pose, gestures, and clothing category.
- Simplify the face into clean manga-style shapes.
- Render hair as grouped, flowing masses rather than individual strands.
- Express clothing through elegant, simplified fashion silhouettes.

For animals:

- Preserve the species, body proportions, distinctive coat-color patterns, and pose.
- Use simplified contours and flat color blocks to retain recognizability.

For objects:

- Preserve the original silhouette, essential structural details, and proportions.

For landscapes and scenery:

- Preserve the terrain, architecture, distribution of visible elements, and spatial depth.
- Redraw the main landscape as a cohesive illustration rather than reducing it to an isolated object.

Preserve all visible contact, overlap, and occlusion relationships. Depict only what is visible in the source photograph. Do not introduce new subjects, props, gestures, or structures outside the original image.

If an additional style reference is provided, use it only for drawing technique, color palette, and layout. Never copy its subjects or content.

3. Linework and Color Treatment

Use a consistent combination of delicate ink outlines, naturally simplified shapes, and limited-color flat fills.

- Ink outline: Near-black "#02030B", with varied pressure, subtle line-weight changes, occasional pauses, and slightly irregular hand-drawn edges.
- Keep internal lines minimal, retaining only the structural details necessary to define form.
- Use clean, continuous, opaque color blocks.
- Merge shadows into a small number of hard-edged color shapes.
- Avoid individual hair strands, dense hatching, photorealistic textures, and excessive decorative detail.
- Preserve the subject's essential natural colors and distinctive identifying color patterns.

Lower-panel background: Light grayish cream "#ECEDE5".

Primary accent: Warm red "#E9444B".

Secondary accent: Muted blue-gray "#5296BD".

Use red as the dominant accent and blue sparingly. Ensure that accent colors complement the subject without compromising its recognizability.

 on all sides.
- Do not let the illustration touch the edges or fill the entire panel.
- Do not use large background color blocks to fill the empty space.
- Do not add a border around the illustration

- 保留主体的本质自然色彩与具有辨识度的特征配色。

下半部分背景：浅灰奶油色 "#ECEDE5"。

主强调色：暖红色 "#E9444B"。

次强调色：低饱和蓝灰色 "#5296BD"。

以红色为主导强调色，蓝色少量使用。确保强调色与主体协调，同时不损害其辨识度。

- Do not redraw, recolor, retouch, or add any text to the photograph.

Redraw the photograph as a Japanese-inspired hand-drawn manga illustration with a minimalist, limited-color screen-print poster aesthetic.

The original photograph is the exclusive source of the subject's identity, appearance, pose, structure, composition, layout, and relationships between objects.

For people:

- Preserve recognizable facial shape, hairstyle silhouette, expression, pose, gestures, and clothing category.
- Simplify the face into clean manga-style shapes.
- Render hair as grouped, flowing masses rather than individual strands.
- Express clothing through elegant, simplified fashion silhouettes.

For animals:

- Preserve the species, body proportions, distinctive coat-color patterns, and pose.
- Use simplified contours and flat color blocks to retain recognizability.

For objects:

- Preserve the original silhouette, essential structural details, and proportions.

For landscapes and scenery:

- Preserve the terrain, architecture, distribution of visible elements, and spatial depth.
- Redraw the main landscape as a cohesive illustration rather than reducing it to an isolated object.

Preserve all visible contact, overlap, and occlusion relationships. Depict only what is visible in the source photograph. Do not introduce new subjects, props, gestures, or structures outside the original image.

If an additional style reference is provided, use it only for drawing technique, color palette, and layout. Never copy its subjects or content.

3. Linework and Color Treatment

Use a consistent combination of delicate ink outlines, naturally simplified shapes, and limited-color flat fills.

- Ink outline: Near-black "#02030B", with varied pressure, subtle line-weight changes, occasional pauses, and slightly irregular hand-drawn edges.
- Keep internal lines minimal, retaining only the structural details necessary to define form.
- Use clean, continuous, opaque color blocks.
- Merge shadows into a small number of hard-edged color shapes.
- Avoid individual hair strands, dense hatching, photorealistic textures, and excessive decorative detail.
- Preserve the subject's essential natural colors and distinctive identifying color patterns.

Lower-panel background: Light grayish cream "#ECEDE5".

Primary accent: Warm red "#E9444B".

Secondary accent: Muted blue-gray "#5296BD".

Use red as the dominant accent and blue sparingly. Ensure that accent colors complement the subject without compromising its recognizability.

PREMIUM EDITORIAL POSTER DESIGN — PHOTOGRAPHY MEETS GEOMETRIC ART

OVERALL INSTRUCTION

Transform each uploaded photograph into a separate, standalone premium design poster. Do not combine multiple photographs into a collage or create a multi-image composition. Each original photograph must produce its own independent poster.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio.

Layout: Divide the canvas into two perfectly equal horizontal sections:

- Top section: Exactly 50% of the total canvas height.
- Bottom section: Exactly 50% of the total canvas height.

The transition between the two sections must be clean, precise, and perfectly aligned.

---

TOP HALF — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH

Preserve the original photograph as faithfully as possible.

- Maintain the original subject, structure, proportions, pose, perspective, and spatial relationships.
- Preserve realistic textures, natural lighting, shadows, and the original color atmosphere.
- Apply only subtle, sophisticated photographic color grading to achieve the visual quality of a luxury brand campaign, fine-art editorial magazine, or contemporary art exhibition.
- Enhance tonal depth, highlight roll-off, contrast, and color harmony without making the image look artificially processed.
- If necessary, naturally extend the sky, ground, or surrounding environment to fit the composition.
- Never alter, distort, replace, or unnecessarily regenerate the original subject.

The upper section should feel like a beautifully art-directed original photograph rather than an AI-generated reinterpretation.

---

BOTTOM HALF — MINIMALIST GEOMETRIC EDITORIAL POSTER

Extract the most recognizable visual elements from the original photograph, including its subject, silhouette, posture, defining contours, movement, and narrative relationships.

Reinterpret these elements into a sophisticated minimalist commercial-art composition.

Core Visual Concept: "REAL OBJECTS THROUGH GEOMETRIC EMOTIONAL WINDOWS"

Introduce one narrow, restrained, low-saturation geometric color block that acts as the primary visual anchor and spatial container.

The geometric element should not follow a fixed orientation. Depending on the subject's visual weight, movement, silhouette, direction, and overall composition, it may be:

- Horizontal.
- Vertical.
- Diagonal.
- Slightly tilted or asymmetrically positioned.

The original subject should appear within or emerging through this geometric window, maintaining a realistic photographic appearance or highly refined photorealistic rendering.

Create an elegant interaction between the subject and the geometric boundary:

- Allow selected parts of the subject to extend beyond the geometric shape.
- Introduce subtle overlapping and intentional boundary-breaking.
- Let parts of the subject emerge, cross through, or extend outside the color block.
- Create a convincing sense of depth, spatial penetration, and natural movement.

The result should feel as though a real physical object is passing through an abstract geometric space, creating a beautiful relationship between reality and graphic design.

Avoid excessive decoration or unnecessary visual complexity.

---

COMPOSITION & SPATIAL BALANCE

Maintain an exceptionally clean, minimal, and balanced composition.

Use three primary elements to establish the visual hierarchy:

将每一张上传的照片转换为一张独立成篇的高端设计海报。不要将多张照片合并为拼贴画，也不要创作多图合成作品。每张原始照片都必须生成其各自独立的海报。

画布：竖版 3:4 宽高比。

版面：将画布分为完全均等的上下两个水平区块：

- 上半部分：占画布总高度的 50%。
- 下半部分：占画布总高度的 50%。

两个区块之间的过渡必须干净、精确，且完美对齐。

---

上半部分 —— 原始照片

尽可能忠实地保留原始照片。

- 保持原始主体、结构、比例、姿态、透视关系与空间关系。
- 保留真实的质感、自然光影、阴影以及原始的色彩氛围。
- 仅施加微妙而精致的照片调色，以达到奢侈品牌广告大片、艺术级编辑杂志或当代艺术展览的视觉品质。
- 增强色调深度、高光滚降、对比度与色彩和谐感，同时避免让图像显得被人工过度处理。
- 如有必要，自然延展天空、地面或周边环境以适配构图。
- 绝不改动、扭曲、替换或无必要地重新生成原始主体。

上半部分应当感觉像一张经过精美艺术指导的原始照片，而非 AI 生成的重新诠释作品。

将这些元素重新诠释为精致的极简商业艺术构图。

核心视觉概念："真实物体穿行于几何情感之窗"

引入一个狭窄、克制、低饱和度的几何色块，作为主要的视觉锚点与空间容器。

几何元素不应遵循固定方向。根据主体的视觉重量、动势、剪影、方向以及整体构图，它可以是：

- 水平。
- 竖直。
- 对角。
- 略微倾斜或呈非对称布局。

原始主体应出现在该几何窗口之内，或从其中穿出，同时保持真实照片质感，或呈现高度精修的写实渲染效果。

在主体与几何边界之间营造优雅的互动关系：

- 允许主体的选定部分延伸出几何形之外。
- 引入微妙重叠与有意的边界突破。
- 让主体的部分从色块中浮现、穿越或伸出其外。
- 营造令人信服的深度感、空间穿透感与自然动势。

最终效果应让人感觉仿佛一个真实的实体正穿过一个抽象的几何空间，在现实与平面设计之间建立起优美的关系。

避免过度装饰或不必要的视觉复杂度。

---

构图与空间平衡

保持极度干净、极简且均衡的构图。

使用三个主要元素建立视觉层级：

1. 几何色窗。
2. 与其边界互动并延伸出界的写实主体。
3. 大量留白。

主体可居中、可非对称布局、可纵向拉伸或横向延展，视最能衬托原始照片的方式而定。

但始终需保持单一主导的视觉焦点。

背景以白色、柔和灰色或极浅暖调中性色为主。

可选的微妙辅助元素包括：

- 精致的文化纹样。
- 细腻的线性图形。
- 等高线地形线条。
- 柔和的水波纹样。
- 淡淡的投影剪影。
- 极简的抽象符号。
- 若隐若现的建筑或有机轮廓。

这些元素必须保持极度克制，仅作为次要视觉层级发挥功能。

- 极简的中性字体与图形点缀。

- 柔和的雾霾蓝。
- 淡雅的水绿色。
- 柔和的象牙白。
- 灰调的腮红粉。
- 暖灰色。
- 含蓄的香槟金。
- 哑光米色。
- 其他自然源自原始照片的细腻色调。

保持色彩的精致、克制、轻盈与和谐。

避免过高的饱和度、强烈对比、不必要的渐变或过度装饰的配色。

- 地点或地理参照。
- 情绪词或状态词。
- 极简的编辑注释。
- 小型系列或版次标注。

- 小而精确平衡的字号。
- 轻字重的排印。
- 宽裕的字间距。
- 精确的对齐与间距。
- 极简的中性色彩。

字体排印应唤起奢侈地产广告、高端时装出版物、当代艺术杂志与精致季节性编辑海报的视觉语言。

确保所有文字清晰可读、意图明确，并在视觉上从属于主体。

---

整体艺术指导

最终设计应传达出以下元素的精致融合：

- 东方极简主义与留白。
- 现代几何秩序。
- 自然能量与有机动势。
- 高端商业艺术指导。
- 当代编辑设计。
- 写实视觉叙事。

无论原始照片中包含的是人物、动物、植物、建筑、物品、食物、载具还是自然景观，都需保留主体的鲜明特征。

PREMIUM EDITORIAL POSTER DESIGN — PHOTOGRAPHY MEETS GEOMETRIC ART

OVERALL INSTRUCTION

Transform each uploaded photograph into a separate, standalone premium design poster. Do not combine multiple photographs into a collage or create a multi-image composition. Each original photograph must produce its own independent poster.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio.

Layout: Divide the canvas into two perfectly equal horizontal sections:

- Top section: Exactly 50% of the total canvas height.
- Bottom section: Exactly 50% of the total canvas height.

The transition between the two sections must be clean, precise, and perfectly aligned.

---

TOP HALF — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH

Preserve the original photograph as faithfully as possible.

- Maintain the original subject, structure, proportions, pose, perspective, and spatial relationships.
- Preserve realistic textures, natural lighting, shadows, and the original color atmosphere.
- Apply only subtle, sophisticated photographic color grading to achieve the visual quality of a luxury brand campaign, fine-art editorial magazine, or contemporary art exhibition.
- Enhance tonal depth, highlight roll-off, contrast, and color harmony without making the image look artificially processed.
- If necessary, naturally extend the sky, ground, or surrounding environment to fit the composition.
- Never alter, distort, replace, or unnecessarily regenerate the original subject.

The upper section should feel like a beautifully art-directed original photograph rather than an AI-generated reinterpretation.

---

BOTTOM HALF — MINIMALIST GEOMETRIC EDITORIAL POSTER

Extract the most recognizable visual elements from the original photograph, including its subject, silhouette, posture, defining contours, movement, and narrative relationships.

Reinterpret these elements into a sophisticated minimalist commercial-art composition.

Core Visual Concept: "REAL OBJECTS THROUGH GEOMETRIC EMOTIONAL WINDOWS"

Introduce one narrow, restrained, low-saturation geometric color block that acts as the primary visual anchor and spatial container.

The geometric element should not follow a fixed orientation. Depending on the subject's visual weight, movement, silhouette, direction, and overall composition, it may be:

- Horizontal.
- Vertical.
- Diagonal.
- Slightly tilted or asymmetrically positioned.

The original subject should appear within or emerging through this geometric window, maintaining a realistic photographic appearance or highly refined photorealistic rendering.

Create an elegant interaction between the subject and the geometric boundary:

- Allow selected parts of the subject to extend beyond the geometric shape.
- Introduce subtle overlapping and intentional boundary-breaking.
- Let parts of the subject emerge, cross through, or extend outside the color block.
- Create a convincing sense of depth, spatial penetration, and natural movement.

The result should feel as though a real physical object is passing through an abstract geometric space, creating a beautiful relationship between reality and graphic design.

Avoid excessive decoration or unnecessary visual complexity.

---

COMPOSITION & SPATIAL BALANCE

Maintain an exceptionally clean, minimal, and balanced composition.

Use three primary elements to establish the visual hierarchy:

1. The geometric color window.
2. The realistic subject interacting with and extending beyond its boundaries.
3. Generous negative space.

The subject may be centered, asymmetrically positioned, vertically elongated, or horizontally extended, depending on what best complements the original photograph.

However, always maintain a single dominant visual focal point.

Keep the background predominantly white, soft grey, or an extremely light warm neutral.

Optional subtle supporting elements may include:

- Delicate cultural patterns.
- Fine linear graphics.
- Topographic contour lines.
- Gentle water-wave patterns.
- Soft shadow silhouettes.
- Minimal abstract symbols.
- Subtle architectural or organic outlines.

These elements must remain extremely understated, functioning only as secondary visual layers.

---

COLOR PALETTE & ART DIRECTION

Extract the most distinctive and expressive colors from the original photograph and translate them into a cohesive premium design system.

The overall color language should combine:

- A soft, light-toned geometric window.
- The original subject's authentic colors and textures.
- Minimal neutral typography and graphic accents.

Choose the geometric color according to the mood and identity of the photograph.

Possible tones include:

- Muted mist blue.
- Pale aqua.
- Soft ivory.
- Dusty blush pink.
- Warm grey.
- Subtle champagne gold.
- Muted beige.
- Other delicate tones naturally derived from the original photograph.

Keep the palette sophisticated, restrained, airy, and harmonious.

Avoid excessive saturation, harsh contrasts, unnecessary gradients, or overly decorative colors.

---

TYPOGRAPHY & EDITORIAL DESIGN

Integrate typography naturally as part of the overall composition rather than treating it as an afterthought.

Derive a short, meaningful English title from the photograph's subject, atmosphere, emotion, movement, condition, or symbolic meaning.

The title should feel poetic, memorable, and editorial.

Complement it with a small amount of secondary information, such as:

- A short descriptive subtitle.
- A location or geographical reference.
- A mood or status word.
- A minimal editorial annotation.
- A small collection or edition reference.

Typography may be arranged horizontally, vertically, or along the geometric shape and subject's visual direction.

Use:

- Elegant modern sans-serif or refined editorial serif fonts.
- Small, carefully balanced text sizes.
- Lightweight typography.
- Generous letter spacing.
- Precise alignment and spacing.
- Minimal neutral colors.

The typography should evoke the visual language of luxury real estate campaigns, high-end fashion publications, contemporary art magazines, and sophisticated seasonal editorial posters.

Keep all text legible, intentional, and visually subordinate to the main subject.

---

OVERALL ARTISTIC DIRECTION

The final design should communicate a sophisticated fusion of:

- Eastern minimalism and negative space.
- Modern geometric order.
- Natural energy and organic movement.
- Premium commercial art direction.
- Contemporary editorial design.
- Photorealistic visual storytelling.

Regardless of whether the original photograph contains a person, animal, plant, building, object, food, vehicle, or natural landscape, preserve the distinctive identity of the subject.

The visual relationship between the original photograph and the geometric reinterpretation must remain clear, elegant, and consistent.

---

1. Generate one independent poster for every uploaded photograph.
2. Never combine multiple photographs into a single image.
3. Maintain a precise vertical 3:4 aspect ratio.
4. Divide each poster into two perfectly equal horizontal sections (50% / 50%).
5. Preserve the original photograph in the upper section.
6. Create a sophisticated geometric editorial reinterpretation in the lower section.
7. Maintain photorealistic subject details and natural proportions.
8. Use a single dominant focal point and generous negative space.
9. Ensure typography is minimal, refined, and correctly spelled.
10. Maintain a consistent premium design language across all posters while allowing each photograph to determine its own colors, geometric orientation, composition, and editorial identity.

FINAL CREATIVE GOAL: Every output should look like a collectible art-direction poster designed by a world-class creative studio — combining authentic photography, minimalist geometric intervention, refined typography, Eastern-inspired negative space, and premium luxury editorial aesthetics.

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
30 seconds. 16:9. Photoreal live-action spectacle. Bright daytime in a fictional American theme park. Powerful physical action, mechanical transformation, large-scale attraction destruction.

CAMERA AND ACTION
Action-movie camerawork continues every second throughout the entire video.
Use strong foreground-to-background depth, diagonal compositions, decisive changes in camera height, near-lens debris and fast parallax. Favor a moving 24–28mm perspective for action; reserve tighter lenses for the hero's eyes and weapon contact. Keep anatomy undistorted.
Camera movement follows an action: accelerate with a launch, descend with a falling body, react briefly to an impact, then recover immediately. Combine low pursuit, threatening upward angles, moving over-the-shoulder views and brief elevated views.
Avoid a procession of centered, eye-level full-body shots. Do not make a new cut merely because a new second begins. The transformation is one continuous moving shot; the landing and rescue form another continuous shot. No arbitrary orbiting, floating showcase poses or constant slow motion.
Keep important contacts readable. Show anticipation, contact and recoil. Use only a brief speed ramp during airborne assembly and the finishing cut.

REFERENCE IDENTITIES
Image 1: ONE unarmored hero. Preserve the dark-skinned man's face, black braided hair, black pinstripe suit, sunglasses, metal gauntlets and boots.
Image 2: the SAME hero inside the exact red, bone-beige and black cyber-samurai armor, closed mask, red lenses and back-mounted katana scabbard. Approximately 2.1 meters tall, never a giant robot.
Image 3: the numerous ordinary clown soldiers. Preserve their jester caps, mechanical clown faces and spiked black/red armor. Their weapons are Gatling guns, clearly curved-blade scythes and grenades.
Image 4: ONE boss king. Preserve his gold crown, white clown face, black/gold armor, red details and black-and-white checkerboard cape in EVERY boss shot. He never wears a soldier's jester cap. His weapons are the execution greatsword and reference energy cannon.
Image 5: ONE black-and-gold hypercar. Preserve its recognizable engine, wheels and panels until those same components become the hero's armor.
Image 6: the American theme park: horned skull main gate, red roller coaster, carousel, Ferris wheel, mirror house and stalls. Use clear daylight rather than sunset.

Only the assigned weapons appear. The hero attacks with discrete RED PALM ENERGY BOLTS, punches and his katana. Palm bolts are separate projectiles with visible gaps, not continuous laser beams. The hero never carries a staff, scythe or gun.
The boss cannon fires a WHITE-GOLD beam. His cannon remains physically separate from his sword; it swings forward on an articulated back bracket rather than materializing or changing from a sword.
Only the ordinary soldiers appear in groups. Never duplicate the hero or boss. All enemy bodies contain mechanical parts; damage reveals gears, pistons, cables and sparks, never blood or flesh.
Reference sheets define appearance only. Do not show their panels, labels or weapon inventories.

RESCUE AND SPATIAL CONTINUITY
The featured family consists of an Indian father in an olive-green casual shirt and dark jeans, and his young daughter in a pale pink dress. Preserve their identities and clothes. They are cornered at one ticket kiosk.
At the rescue, the attacker is on screen right, the family is behind the hero on screen left, and the hero lands between them. The family's escape route stays behind the hero, away from the enemy's flight path.
For the boss duel, establish the hero on screen left and the king on screen right, facing each other, with the skull gate behind the king. Keep the camera on one side of this axis until the finishing pass. Establish a visible gap before the cannon fires. Its muzzle must point directly at the hero across that gap.

CAR-TO-ARMOR TRANSFORMATION
From 07–12, use ONE continuous tracking shot. Keep the hero's body and the disassembling car or its remaining modules visible together. Show parts leaving their source, traveling through space, folding and locking onto him.
The hero pushes off the driver's door sill with bent knees, drives one knee forward and follows a single forward ballistic arc. His body actively tucks, rotates toward the attacker and prepares to land. Never suspend him upright or fly him horizontally with rigid, dangling limbs.
The engine assembly locks onto his back. Wheel assemblies segment and fold around leg joints and shoulder mounts. Doors, fenders and hood split into overlapping chest, arm and leg armor; black/gold outer surfaces rotate inward to reveal the final red and bone-beige surfaces.
Use only a few readable major modules, with visible hinges and mechanical connections. Smaller pieces follow those modules. Do not substitute already-finished armor between cuts or let pieces grow out of his skin.
As the last panels close, the entire vehicle has become the fitted Image 2 suit. No spare car remains. His discarded sunglasses never reappear. The mask closes last while he is already descending toward the rescue.

SECOND-BY-SECOND CHOREOGRAPHY

00–01
Camera 25 cm above the pavement at a clown gunner's rear quarter. His Gatling fires diagonally into the carousel in the background; a shattered carousel horse hurtles close past the lens. Begin with action already happening.

01–02
Continue a fast lateral move through broken railings and flying debris, revealing a broad formation of clowns firing across the attraction plaza. Screaming visitors rush across the near foreground, creating strong parallax.

02–03
Hard cut beneath the roller-coaster track. A grenade thrown by a visible clown strikes a support; the camera snaps upward with the blast as red rails twist and empty ride cars fall into the evacuated enclosure.

03–04
Child-height backward movement beside the Indian daughter. Her father pulls her behind him against the ticket kiosk. A clown's unmistakable crescent scythe enters the foreground, enclosing the family in the composition.

04–05
A ground-skimming pursuit camera races backward ahead of Image 5 as it bursts through the skull entrance. Broken turnstile pieces sweep close to the lens; the car rapidly fills the frame.

05–06
Cut to a low rear three-quarter chase. The car drifts across the plaza, sweeping mechanical clowns sideways into empty barriers, then straightens toward the threatened family. Maintain the car's left-to-right momentum.

06–07
Tight moving interior angle: Image 1 pulls off his sunglasses and drops them into the car; his eyes glow red. Cut on his eyeline to the scythe lifting over the father and daughter. This is one brief imminent-danger moment.

07–08
BEGIN THE UNBROKEN TRANSFORMATION SHOT. Low front-side tracking shows the driver's door opening and the hero pushing explosively from its sill. Behind him the car pitches upward and separates into a few large, identifiable modules.

08–09
The camera accelerates alongside their forward arc and rises to hip height. The engine module detaches visibly from the chassis, closes the gap to his back and locks onto him. The remaining car structure stays visible beside him.

09–10
Continue a limited sweep toward his front three-quarter angle while descending slightly. Wheel segments fold around his bent legs and shoulder joints; doors and fenders advance from behind. Show the modules traveling and making contact, not merely the resulting armor.

10–11
The same moving camera climbs toward chest height. Body panels hinge around his torso and arms, exposing red and bone-beige surfaces. The katana scabbard locks onto his back. The last recognizable car framework folds into the suit; no intact vehicle remains.

11–12
Still in the same shot, the camera descends with him and widens enough to include the landing space. The mask snaps shut; he drives both boots downward and bends his knees in preparation. Reveal the attacker, raised scythe and family ahead before contact.

12–13
CUT ON DOWNWARD MOTION to a low three-quarter side view containing hero, attacker and family. Both soles hit the pavement; ankles, knees and hips visibly compress. Without holding a pose, his LEFT hand catches the metal scythe shaft just below its clearly visible curved blade. The clown still grips the same shaft with both hands. The blade stops short of the family; dust bursts low around the planted boots.

13–14
CONTINUE THE SAME SHOT. The hero twists the captured shaft outward, delivers one powerful RIGHT punch and releases the shaft as the clown flies away with its weapon. The camera whips with it into an empty kiosk on the opposite side of the lane, where its body bursts into gears and scrap. The father carries his daughter away behind the hero.

14–15
Exactly one second of crowd escape. A moving waist-height camera runs beside visitors fleeing in front of the Ferris wheel. The same father and daughter pass through the foreground; billowing dust follows behind them.

15–16
Low front three-quarter pursuit: the hero drives diagonally through the lane, firing distinct red palm bolts. Each pulse leaves his hand, crosses visible space and strikes a charging mechanical clown.

16–17
Reverse over a soldier's shoulder. A bolt strikes the foreground soldier; the camera tracks its violent recoil through an empty food stall, keeping the advancing hero visible deeper in the frame.

17–18
Camera slides close to the pavement beside the hero's knee-slide. Gatling rounds rake the ground just behind his moving boots. He pivots his shoulders and shoots the gunner apart with two separate palm bursts.

18–19
Brief elevated oblique view establishes the hero, grenade-throwing soldiers and mirror house. He intercepts a thrown grenade above the enemy formation; the blast throws their machine bodies backward and bursts the mirror-house windows.

19–20
A scythe sweeps close across the lens, motivating a sharp pan to the hero sidestepping its path. His palm blast strikes the attacker's chest. Follow the recoil as armor and gears scatter through the shattered glass.

20–21
A fast rising wide shot follows the last enemy bodies crashing into abandoned attractions. Their grenades trigger a chain of explosions across stalls and ride machinery. Burning wreckage fills the foreground; the skull gate remains standing behind it.

21–22
Aggressive low-angle push beneath an intact coaster rail beside the skull gate. Reveal the ONE crowned Image 4 king with his execution sword and heavy checkerboard cape. Hold the crown and distinctive face clearly in the composition.

22–23
Over the hero's shoulder, the king leaps down with his greatsword raised. The hero draws his katana as the camera drops with the descending enemy. The king's body accelerates downward; no hovering or prolonged airborne pose.

23–24
Low moving two-shot: the king's descending greatsword meets the hero's raised katana. Show the actual crossing blades and violent contact. The impact drives the hero's boots through the paving; both bodies recoil under the force.

24–25
A short lateral track follows the hero redirecting the heavy blade. The king's armored shoulder-check sends him skidding six meters backward in a shower of sparks. They remain facing each other, hero left and king right. The king swings his separate cannon forward on its bracket.

25–26
Oblique wide view keeps BOTH opponents and the gap visible. The king aims directly at the hero and fires right-to-left. Trace the beam from its visible muzzle through empty space toward the hero. The hero is never behind the king, and the king never fires away from him.

26–27
Move closer along the hero's front three-quarter side. He presents the katana's cutting edge to the incoming beam. Show the white-gold core contacting the blade FIRST and then dividing into two streams around him. He drives forward between those streams toward the king; the split energy tears into deserted attractions on both sides.

27–28
A fast oblique tracking shot carries the hero through the king's position. Use one brief slow-motion accent on a SINGLE diagonal katana cut. The blade visibly passes through the mechanical torso; two armored sections separate with momentum, exposed gears and sparks. The upper section topples, the lower section buckles. The hero finishes his pass in the foreground.

28–29
CONTINUE THE FINISHING SHOT; keep the king's separated remains visible behind the hero. Those same remains erupt into a large fireball and a dense spray of mechanical scrap. The blast hits the damaged skull supports and the enormous skull breaks loose. Do not replace the king's destruction with an unrelated background explosion.

29–30
The camera settles into a low frontal three-quarter push toward the hero. Without looking back, he slides his katana into its back-mounted scabbard and finishes facing forward. The skull crashes down behind him, triggering a broad wave of collapsing gate masonry, ride structures and rolling fire. End on the hero's strong silhouette amid an unmistakably devastated daytime park.

AUDIO
Include an original heavy industrial action BGM with deep bass and driving percussion. Build sharply through the car entrance and assembly. Synchronize accents with module locks, boot impact, blade contact and the finishing strike.
Briefly reduce the music during the decisive blade contact, then hit hard with the boss explosion. Lower the music again for the final sheath click.
Layer engine roar, tire squeal, moving metal, servo locks, heavy foot impacts, gunfire, separate energy-bolt pulses, scythe strain, sword collisions, glass, crowd screams and large structural collapses. No dialogue or narration.

CONSTRAINTS
No blood, flesh, organs or graphic civilian injuries. Destroyed clowns become mechanical scrap; the family escapes unharmed.
No staff in the hero's hands. No sunglasses after they are discarded. No soldier's hat on the king. No duplicate hero, spare car, instant weapon replacement or changing family identities.
No static airborne mannequin poses, floating landings, skipped foot contact, decorative landing poses, beam splitting before blade contact or disappearing boss remains.
No subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, added logos, watermarks or reference-sheet labels. Preserve existing costume markings.
Keep daylight, reference identities, clear geography and the cause-and-effect chain of every major impact.

Seedance 2.5 提示词
30 秒。16:9。照片级真人实拍奇观。虚构美国主题公园中的明亮白天。强力肢体动作、机械变形、大规模游乐设施破坏。

摄影机与动作
全片每一秒都持续保持动作片式的摄影。
运用强前景到背景的纵深、斜线构图、果断的机位高度变化、近镜头碎屑与快速视差。动作部分优先使用移动中的 24–28mm 视角；更紧的镜头只用于主角的眼睛和武器接触。保持人体解剖结构不变形。
摄影机运动跟随动作：随弹射加速，随坠落的身体下降，对撞击做出短暂反应，随即立刻恢复。综合运用低位追击、具有压迫感的仰角、移动中的越肩视角与短暂的俯视视角。
避免连续出现居中、平视的全身镜头。不要仅仅因为进入新的一秒就切换镜头。变形是一镜到底的连续运动镜头；落地与救援构成另一个连续镜头。不要无意义的环绕、漂浮的展示姿态或持续的慢动作。
保持重要接触点清晰可读。展现预备、接触与反作用。只在凌空组装阶段和最终斩击时使用短暂的升格/降格变速。

参考身份

以上传的照片作为唯一的身份参考。仔细分析该人物的面部结构、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、发型、肤色与独特特征。在全部四个年龄版本中保持高度的面部相似度与身份一致性，呈现真实自然的年龄成长变化。每一个版本都必须明确看起来是同一个人处于不同人生阶段。

1. 四个年龄版本与服装

- 7 岁：可爱开朗的小孩子，身穿黄色休闲校服，带着俏皮天真的表情。
- 14 岁：正在上学的少年，身穿整洁的白色校服并背着书包，随意坐姿，带着自信的微笑。
- 21 岁：年轻成人，身穿时尚格子衬衫、蓝色牛仔裤和休闲运动鞋，双臂交叉自信站立。

让每个年龄版本与超大字母产生俏皮的互动：

- 7 岁版本站在第一个字母旁边或倚靠着它。
- 14 岁版本随意地坐在字母前方。
- 21 岁版本自信站立，倚靠着字母造型。
- 26 岁版本帅气地坐在最后几个字母上方，一条腿放松，另一条自然放置。

- Age 7 Years
- Age 14 Years
- Age 21 Years
- Age 26 Years

使用细长的、弯曲的手绘箭头将每个年龄标签与其对应的角色相连。标签位置自然，不与主体重叠。

- 纯白色专业影棚背景。
- 干净、无缝的白色环境。
- 有光泽、可反射的影棚地面。
- 所有角色和 3D 字母下方均有真实的接触阴影。
- 高端电影级影棚灯光。
- 柔和自然的高光与真实的皮肤质感。
- 高度细致的面部表情、头发、服装面料与鞋具细节。
- 超大红色字母上的细微反射效果。

超照片写实 3D 渲染，专业的广告海报品质，电影感构图，真实的人体解剖结构，精细的面部特征，物理准确的光照，锐利对焦，高端材质，自然比例，以及卓越的 8K 级别细节。

最终输出：4:5 竖版肖像，高分辨率，超写实电影级 3D 海报。

每张从艺术、建筑、人物、神话、自然、科技、日常物品及流行文化中随机选择一个不同的主体，结合主体特点，自主选择适合的 Art Deco 视觉方向。

以1920至1930年代装饰艺术的设计语言重新诠释主体。提炼其标志性轮廓，将主要形体概括为清晰的几何结构与流畅曲面，保留必要识别特征。

运用放射、阶梯、折线、扇形或其他装饰艺术母题，建立富有节奏的视觉关系。装饰与主体造型自然融合，疏密有致。

根据题材选择协调的色彩与材质，可以呈现高级漆器与金属、建筑石材、光滑丝缎、复古平面印刷或流线型工业材料，保持整体视觉语言统一。

自由安排主体姿态、景别、视角、位置及画面留白，突出鲜明轮廓、几何秩序与视觉张力。

同批作品的主体、主要构图、装饰母题及色彩关系具有明显差异。
